description: Quwi's Chess Patches 1.9.21: a patch of its own finds sf-bridge on your Wi-Fi and fills the computer's address in. Addresses that worked are kept, and a review can look around by itself when the set address stops answering. The sf-bridge firewall command now works on public networks too. Includes the 4.10.18 Home tile fix from 1.9.20 and everything from 1.9.19.
